description: The islands are examined from their volcanic birth through the evolution of their wildlife and the forces that continue to alter both land and life.

s01e01.description: The opening chapter follows the volcanic life cycle of the Galápagos and the unusual animals that have adapted to survive on young, isolated and continually changing islands.

s01e02.description: Flightless cormorants, giant tortoises and other distinctive species reveal how isolation shaped the islands’ wildlife and helped transform scientific understanding of evolution.

s01e03.description: The final chapter examines the environmental pressures still reshaping the archipelago and the specialized adaptations that allow its species to persist as conditions change.
